facebookAccount.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; SM-S928B) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
facebookAccount.notes: time the system automatically retrieves new cookies from email/password, unit is minute, if you set null, the system will not automatically retrieve new cookies. To use this feature you need to enter the account email and password above

notesLanguage: change to your language with ISO 639-1 code, available languages: vi (Vietnamese), en (English)
noPrefixNotes: When true, Bot Admins (role 2) and Developers (role 4) can run commands without the prefix
notes_premiumUsers: List of user IDs with premium access (role 3)
notes_devUsers: List of developer IDs with full access (role 4)

whiteListMode.notes: if you enable this feature, only the ids in the whiteListIds list can use the bot

whiteListModeThread.notes: if you enable this feature, only the thread in the whiteListThreadIds list can use the bot
whiteListModeThread.how_it_work: if you enable both whiteListMode and whiteListModeThread, the system will check if the user is in whiteListIds, then check if the thread is in whiteListThreadIds, if one of the conditions is true, the user can use the bot

database.notes: (1) type selects 'json' or 'sqlite' or 'mongodb'. (2) autoSyncWhenStart true makes the bot start slower. (3) autoRefreshThreadInfoFirstTime refreshes thread info on the first message since start

spamProtection.notes: Auto-ban threads when users spam commands. commandThreshold: number of commands, timeWindow: seconds, banDuration: hours

autoRestart.notes: If you set time to 0, false or null, the bot will not auto restart

autoUptime.notes: timeInterval is in seconds. Put your Render URL in url (example: https://ton-bot.onrender.com) to keep the service awake

autoLoadScripts.notes: automatically reloads scripts when they change

restartListenMqtt.notes: timeRestart and delayAfterStopListening are in milliseconds. Kept disabled to avoid periodic restarts

notiWhenListenMqttError.notes: Notification sent when the mqtt connection stops (locked account, spam block, ...). Set enable to true to use it

gmail.note: Bot will use gmailAccount to send email to emailGetNoti, separate several emails by comma or space

telegram.note: Can send notifications to many chatId, separate by comma or space

discordHook.note: Can send notifications to many webhookUrl, separate by comma or space

typingIndicator.notes: Shows typing indicator before sending messages. duration is in milliseconds

optionsFca.notes: nkx-fca options — see node_modules/nkx-fca/README.md for full documentation

notifyAdminOnDeploy.notes: Si enable est true, le bot envoie un message en PV à chaque ID de adminBot dès qu'il démarre/est déployé. Le message peut contenir {botName}, {time} et {botID}.
